senses.gloss:
m. (-जः)
A husband.
E.
प्र before जन to be born, ड aff. who is re-born in his children; see प्रजा.

f. (-जा)
1 Progeny, offspring.
2 People, subjects.
E.
प्र before जन to be born, aff. ड and टाप्.

mn. (-नः-नं)
1 Impregnating, begetting.
2 Impregnation or pregnancy of cattle in general.
3 The season for a cow's taking the bull, &c.
m. (-नः)
A progenitor, an impregnator.
E.
प्र before जन to be born, घञ् aff.

n. (-नं)
A goad.
E.
प्र before अज to go, in the causal form, aff. ल्युट्.

n. (-नं)
1 The vulva.
2 Birth, production.
3 Going well or quickly.
E.
प्र before जन to be born, aff. ल्युट्.

adv. ind.
For the sake of procreation.
E.
प्रजन, and अर्थ on account of.

f. (-का)
A mother.
E.
प्र before जन to be born, aff. वुन्.

mfn. (-ष्णुः-ष्णुः-ष्णु)
1 Being born or produced.
2 Producing, generating.
3 Growing or standing, (as corn.)
E.
प्र before जन to be born, इष्णुच् aff.

m. (-ल्पः)
1 Prattle, gossip.
2 Talking heedlessly to a lover.
E.
प्र, and जल्प talking.

m. (-वः)
Great speed.
E.
प्र before जव quickness.

mfn. (-वी-विनी-वि)
Swift, speedy.
m. (-वी)
A runner, a courier, an express.
E.
प्र before जव speed, aff. इनि.

mfn. (-मः-मा-मं)
Desirous of offspring.
E.
प्रजा, and काम desire.

m. (-रः)
Waking, watching.
E.
प्र before जागर wakefulness.

f. (-ता)
A woman who has borne a child.
E.
प्र before जात born, (from whom.)

mfn. (-दः-दा-दं)
1 Who or what gives offspring.
2 What removes barrenness, (as a medicine, &c.)
E.
प्रजा, and द what gives.

n. (-नं)
Silver.
E.
प्रजा people, and दान gift.

m. (-र्म्मः)
The duty of children or of subjects.
E.
प्रजा, and धर्म्म duty.

mfn. (-नन्-नन्ती-नत्)
1 Sensible, intelligent.
2 Knowing, understanding.
f. (-न्ती)
A sensible woman.
E.
प्र before ज्ञा to know, aff. शतृ.

m. (-पः)
A king.
E.
प्रजा people, subjects, and प who protects, from पा with क aff.

m. (-तिः)
1 A name of BRAHMĀ.
2 The epithet common to the ten divine personages, who were first created by BRAHMA; they are also termed Brahmādikas, and their names are MARĪCI, ATRI, AṄGIRAS, PULASTYA, PULAHA, KRATU, PRACETAS, VASIṢṬHA, BHṚGU, and NĀRADA: some authorities make the Prajāpatis only seven in number, others reduce them to three, or DAKṢA, NĀRADA, and BHṚGU, and others make them twenty-one.
3 A king, a sovereign.
4 A father.
5 A son-in-law, a daughter's husband.
6 The sun.
7 Fire.
8 A name of VIŚVAKARMA.
E.
प्रजा people or the world, and पति master.

f. (-नी)
A mother, or bearer of children.
E.
प्र before जन to be born, णिनि aff.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
1 Having progeny.
2 Having subjects.
f. (-ती)
1 A brother's wife.
2 The wife of an elder brother.
3 A mother.
E.
प्रजा offspring, and मतुप poss. aff.

f. (-द्धिः)
Increase of progeny.
E.
प्रजा, and वृद्धि increase.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Favourable or good for children or subjects, &c. kind to them, useful to them, &c.
n. (-तं)
Water.
E.
प्रजा people, and हित friendly, useful.

m. (-नः)
Air, wind.
E.
प्र before जि to surpass or overcome, क्त aff., form irr.

n. (-नं)
Livelihood, subsistence.
E.
प्र, and जीवन living.

mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं)
Strongly attached to, devoted to, intent on.
E.
प्र, and जुष to serve, aff. क्त.

m. (-रः)
A king.
E.
प्रजा subject, and ईश्वर lord.

mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं)
1 Wise, learned; also प्राज्ञ.
2 Bandy-legged, having the knees far apart: see प्रज्ञु.
f. (-ज्ञा)
1 A clever or sensible woman.
2 Understanding, wisdom, knowledge.
3 The [] goddess of arts and eloquence, SARASVATĪ.
E.
प्र before ज्ञा, to know, aff. क.

mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं)
1 Patient in investigation.
2 Wise, clever, sensible.
m. (-ज्ञः)
1 A Paṇḍita, a learned or wise man.
2 A skilful or clever man.
f. (-ज्ञा)
Knowledge, understanding.
f. (-ज्ञा-ज्ञी)
A clever or intelligent woman.
f. (-ज्ञी)
The wife of a Paṇḍita.
E.
प्र and आङ before ज्ञा to know, क aff.

f. (-प्तिः)
An appointment, an agreement, an engagement.
(-प्ती)
One of the Vidyā Devīs of the Jainas.
E.
प्र before ज्ञा to know, causal v., aff. क्तिन्.

m. (-यः)
A Bauddha saint; also MAÑJUGHOṢA.
E.
प्रज्ञा knowledge, कै to sound, अङ् aff.

m. (-क्षुः)
A name of DHṚTARĀṢṬRA.
E.
प्रज्ञा, and चक्षुस् the eye: being physically blind.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Known, understood.
2 Famous, notorious.
E.
प्र, and ज्ञात known.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Wise, learned.
n. (-नं)
1 Knowledge, wisdom.
2 A mark, a sign, a token.
E.
प्र exceeding, ज्ञान knowledge.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
Wise, intelligent.
E.
प्रज्ञा, and मतुप् aff.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Silly, unwise, ignorant.
E.
प्रज्ञा, and हीन void of.

m. (-ज्ञी)
A sage, a scholar, a wise or learned man.
E.
प्रज्ञा wisdom, aff. इनि.

mfn. (-ज्ञुः-ज्ञुः-ज्ञु)
Bandy-legged, having the knees far apart.
E.
प्र separate, जानु the knee, and ज्ञु substituted.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Blazing, radiant.
2 Burnt.
E.
प्र implying excess, ज्वलित burning.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Lighted, kindled.
E.
प्र before ज्वल to blaze, causal v., क्त aff.

m. (-कः)
A coachman, a driver.
E.
प्र before अज to go, causal form, aff. वुन्.

m. (-त्यः)
1 A form of marriage, the gift of a girl, respectfully by her father to her lover.
2 A name of Allahabad or Prayāga.
3 The first of the persons, called Vāsudevas, by the Jainas.
n. (-त्यं)
1 A sort of penance, eating once a day for three days in the morning, once in the night for three days, subsisting three days on food given as alms, and fasting three days more.
2 A particular sacrifice performed before appointing a daughter to raise issue in default of male heirs.
3 The asterism Rohiṇī.
f. (-त्या)
Giving away the whole of one's property before entering upon the life of an ascetic or mendicant.
E.
प्रजापति BRAHMĀ, and ण्यत् aff.

m. (-ता)
A coachman, a charioteer.
E.
प्र before अज to go, causal v., तृच् aff.

n. (-त्वं)
Learning, wisdom.
E.
प्राज्ञ, and त्व aff.; also with तल्, प्राज्ञता.

n. (-नं)
Respect for learned men.
E.
प्राज्ञ, and मान respect.

mfn. (-नी-निनी-नि)
Respecting men of learning.
E.
प्राज्ञमान, and इनि aff.

mfn. (-ज्यः-ज्या-ज्यं)
Much, many.
E.
प्र before अञ्ज to pervade, aff. क्यप्.
